item.title: Tree falls on Disneyland guests during windy night
item.description: A Nevada couple visiting Disneyland was treated for minor injuries after a tree fell in the park Tuesday night.

item.title: Family of fallen officer hopes urgent action by state lawmakers will help get justice
item.description: State lawmakers are taking urgent action that could lead to justice for fallen Cleveland Police Officer Jamieson Ritter.

item.title: LeBron James scrutinized over Israel comments at 2026 NBA All-Star Game
item.description: Mehdi Hasan, a frequent critic of Israel, penned an open letter to James after his comments.

item.title: Listen: Calls for help after Cleveland ambulance gets stuck in snow
item.description: Recordings just released to the FOX 8 I-Team show what happened when a Cleveland ambulance got stuck in the snow.

item.title: Emmanuel Clase, Luis Ortiz fight pitch-rigging case as spring training starts
item.description: A scheduled spring fraud trial for two Cleveland Guardians pitchers accused of colluding with sports bettors to rig bets and betray “America's pastime” will likely be postponed until October, a federal judge said Wednesday as the men pleaded not guilty to a rewritten indictment.

item.title: Man accused of killing Aliza Sherman wants changes to bond
item.description: The FOX 8 I-Team has learned that the man accused of killing Aliza Sherman is asking a judge to modify his bond restrictions and to allow his defense team to test additional evidence.

item.title: 'Pulp Fiction' actor died from accidental shooting: Reports
item.description: Officials have revealed a cause of death for "Pulp Fiction" actor Peter Greene, who was found dead in his New York City home late last year.

item.title: SEE IT: Ice jams piling up in Northeast Ohio
item.description: River ice that spent weeks forming during a record-breaking cold streak is now breaking loose, and it's expected to cause flooding.

item.title: Power's out for 2,700 FirstEnergy customers in Cleveland
item.description: More than 13,000 FirstEnergy customers lost power on Wednesday afternoon, according to the utility.

item.title: FORECAST: Rain and storms possible before dropping temps, wintry mix
item.description: Another system will bring in a round of the rain and rumbles of thunder Thursday night into Friday morning. Locally heavy rain possible with a few thunderstorms.
